slices.raw_text:
service timestamps debug datetime msec
boot-start-marker
boot-end-marker
hostname r-cisco
no ip domain lookup
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 10.0.1.1 255.255.255.0
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
end

set system host-name r-junos
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.2.1/30
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0
set routing-options router-id 10.0.2.1
set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT term ACCEPT then accept

daemon TerminAttr
   no shutdown
!
hostname r-eos
transceiver qsfp default-mode 4x10G
mlag configuration
   domain-id leaf
ip routing
interface Ethernet1
   no switchport
   ip address 10.0.3.1/30
management api http-commands
   no shutdown
